# Technical diagram visual review

Review the rendered artifact, not only SVG source.

Check:

- **truth** — every arrow/group/label corresponds to the intended system relation;
- **hierarchy** — the primary path/boundary is obvious;
- **legibility** — text remains readable at normal viewing size;
- **spacing** — nodes and labels do not collide;
- **routing** — connectors are unambiguous and crossings are limited;
- **consistency** — repeated concepts use repeated visual treatment;
- **scope** — the diagram does not mix unrelated detail levels;
- **export** — SVG and PNG, when both exist, communicate the same content.

A beautiful diagram with a false dependency is a failed technical artifact.
